class BadInput:
    text: str

def sum_parsed(xs: list[str]) -> int fail BadInput:
    """Parse every string as an integer and return their sum."""
    ex sum_parsed([]) == 0
    ex sum_parsed(["1", "2", "3"]) == 6
    ex sum_parsed(["1", "foo", "3"]) == Err(BadInput("foo"))
    total = 0
    for s in xs:
        n = s.parse_int() else fail BadInput(s.copy())
        total += n
    return total
